title: Teaching
text:

title: Pieter Kleer
text:
Welcome
This is my personal (academic) website. I am an assistant professor in the department of Econometrics and Operations Research (EOR) at the Tilburg School of Economics and Management (TiSEM).
I completed my PhD research at CWI in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, under the supervision of Guido Schäfer. After that I was a postdoctoral researcher at the Max Planck Institute for Informatics in Saarbrücken, Germany, in the D1 group of (at the time) Kurt Mehlhorn. I completed my Bachelor and Master studies at the TU Delft.


Contact
Pieter Kleer  Warandelaan 2 (K 410) 5037 AB Tilburg Netherlands  Email: p (dot) s (dot) kleer (at) tilburguniversity (dot) edu

title: Research
text:
I mostly work on problems at the intersection of economics and (theoretical) computer science, an area often referred to as EconCS. My current main research interests here are mechanism design, resource allocation games and online algorithms.
I have also worked on Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods for the approximate sampling and counting of combinatorial objects, mostly for the problem of sampling graphs with given degrees (and related problems).

title: Research
text:

My papers sometimes first appear in peer-reviewed conference proceedings, and most of them are then sent to a journal afterwards (as is common practice in the area of theoretical computer science). Some of my more economical or mathematical works are sent directly to a journal.
